platform: Windows 11 (26200), Node 22 test runner, reference server on loopback HTTP
what: Client publish/revoke for the self-hosted mini-server (product decision of 29/09/2026) plus the reference server itself, exercised end to end over real loopback HTTP

pieces.client: src/lib/sharePublish.ts — endpoint validation (http/https only, no credentials/query in the URL), publish request (PUT + Bearer + bounded duration 1 h–30 d + 240 KiB body), revoke request (deny-only DELETE), response parsing that refuses to announce a URL before the server's real 201
pieces.server: scripts/share-server.mjs — single-file zero-dependency Node service: token-gated publish/revoke, token-free read, expiry enforced on every read, revocation observable from any client (the same 404), optional JSON state file for restart survival
pieces.tests: test/sharePublish.test.ts — 9 tests, the last four spawn the real reference server on an ephemeral port

measured.publishWithTokenReadWithoutAny: PUT with 'Bearer test-token-123' → 201 {url}; a wrong token → 403; a second client GETs the bundle with no token at all → 200
measured.incompleteExportRefused: a bundle without a body → 400 'incomplete export'; an oversized body → 413; nothing was published (GET → 404)
measured.revocationObservable: DELETE with the token → 204; subsequent GET → 404 with and without the token; an unknown id → 404
measured.expiryHonored: a bundle published with an already-past expiresAt → 201 but GET → 404

remaining: No UI wiring yet (the retired SharePanel surface returns later); the service itself was exercised on loopback only — a real LAN/VPS host, a real second device and token management on the user's side stay unmeasured.
